title: Reject path-decorated aesthetic-only evidence or narrow the rubber-stamp claim
hypothesis: A fluent stamp whose only evidence is a repo path plus elegance language still Advances.
falsification_condition: Validate rejects path-plus-aesthetic-only evidence, or the claim is narrowed to the operational class already tested.
source_finding: Path-bearing aesthetic evidence still counts as a concrete anchor

title: Prove draft uptake or align success criterion 3 with spawn-only
hypothesis: Reject/risk drafts are reviewed within one loop; otherwise create tasks instead of being buried is unmet.
falsification_condition: Success criteria are rewritten to drafts written, not queued, or a later loop leaves drafts with no disposition.
source_finding: Negatives become result-dir drafts, not shared-queue tasks

title: Keep evalgate as a non-advantage implementation or replace it with schema+jq
hypothesis: MESH-108 success criteria stay met if Validate/Spawn/CheckTasks are expressed only in schema plus a CI jq/shell hook.
falsification_condition: A later round scores simpler_baseline_advantage >= 3 or claims the Go package beats JSON Schema.
source_finding: schema+jq still ties the existence claim; the Go package is an extra encoding

title: Treat '.' as an unsafe task id and test path-escape IDs
hypothesis: Rejecting '.' and testing ../x, foo/bar, and '.' will close the residual path-join hole.
falsification_condition: CheckTasks still treats id='.' as safe, or ../x is not blocked.
source_finding: safeTaskID allows '.' and has no committed escape-id table test

title: Reject slash-gamed aesthetic evidence
hypothesis: Requiring a path-shaped token will reject looks good / ship it while still accepting internal/evalgate/gate.go and 200ms.
falsification_condition: looks good / ship it still passes Validate, or evidence naming internal/evalgate/gate.go is rejected.
source_finding: Any slash still rubber-stamps aesthetic evidence
